mapper.select: SELECT * FROM Subscription WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Subscription (status, start_date, end_date, member_id, plan_id) VALUES (#{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{memberId}, #{planId})
mapper.update: UPDATE subscription s LEFT JOIN payment p ON s.subs_id = p.subs_id SET s.status = 'CANCELED', s.canceled_at = now() WHERE p.token = #{token};
